level_1_raw.name: Level 1: The Raw Agent
level_1_raw.description: No harness, no loop, no graph. A single coder node operating without any safety nets. Expect lots of failures — learn what breaks when an agent has zero infrastructure.
level_1_raw.tutorial: Lesson: Without any engineering infrastructure, a raw LLM agent is nearly useless. It hallucinates tools, corrupts its own work, and forgets context after just a few steps.

intro.analogy: This is a 2023-era raw agent — a warrior charging into the dungeon with no armor.
intro.watchFor: Watch where it dies: hallucinated tool call, file corrosion, or memory overflow?

debrief.conceptRef: Tool grounding · Sandbox · Version control · Context window
debrief.summary: You saw it firsthand: without workspace, sandbox, Git, and a memory buffer, an agent can barely complete any task. Infrastructure is not optional — it is the starting point.

level_2_harness.name: Level 2: Safety Harness
level_2_harness.description: Unlock workspace, sandbox, Git, and memory buffer. Still no loop strategy, so a single test failure means the task is abandoned. Learn how infrastructure reduces common failure modes.
level_2_harness.tutorial: Lesson: Infrastructure (workspace, sandbox, git, memory) eliminates the most basic failure modes, but without a self-correction loop, the agent still gives up on the first error.

intro.analogy: You armored the warrior — but you have not taught it to get back up after a fall.
intro.watchFor: Watch what happens after the first test failure — does the agent just give up?

debrief.summary: With gear equipped, hallucinations and file corrosion vanish. But without a loop, one failure still means task abandoned — next level teaches the agent to climb back up.

level_3_loop.name: Level 3: The Loop
level_3_loop.description: Unlock the ReAct+Reflexion loop strategy with up to 5 retries and a test_pass stop condition. The agent can now recover from failures automatically. Master the feedback loop.
level_3_loop.tutorial: Lesson: A retry loop dramatically improves success rates, but without memory isolation, repeated retries fill up the context window, leading to infinite loop traps and token waste.

intro.analogy: Blind retry is reloading a save. Reflexion is fighting again with XP. That difference is Loop Engineering.
intro.watchFor: Compare Blind Retry vs ReAct+Reflexion — which one actually climbs the success curve? When does the memory waterline overflow?

debrief.summary: The self-correction loop you just configured is formally called Reflexion: test fails → reflect on why → retry with the lesson. Blind retries do not decay; reflection lowers the error rate each round.

level_4_graph.name: Level 4: The Graph
level_4_graph.description: Unlock the multi-agent graph: planner → coder → reviewer. Each agent has isolated memory, and the chain provides built-in review. Full harness + loop enabled. Reach near-perfect reliability.
level_4_graph.tutorial: Lesson: Splitting work across specialized sub-agents with isolated memory is the key to scaling agent reliability. The planner decomposes tasks, the coder implements, and the reviewer catches mistakes — each with its own context window.

intro.analogy: One person doing everything vs founding a company: who you hire, what process you set, and whether each gets a private desk decides the KPI.
intro.watchFor: Watch how topology affects outcomes — chain, parallel, and review-feedback each trade success rate against token cost.

debrief.conceptRef: LangGraph StateGraph · CrewAI roles · Context isolation
debrief.summary: Isolated-memory sub-agents stop contexts from polluting each other. Topology is not decoration — parallel spreads risk, feedback enables rework, and every structure has a calculable trade-off.

harness.title: Harness Configuration
harness.workspaceDesc: Prevents hallucinated tool calls by giving the agent a real file system
harness.sandboxDesc: Secure execution environment — run code safely without breaking things
harness.gitDesc: Tracks every change so the agent can roll back corrupted files

loop.title: Loop Strategy
loop.noneDesc: Single-pass execution — the agent stops on the first error
loop.retryBlindDesc: Reload the save: same error rate every attempt — no learning from failure
loop.reactReflexionDesc: Fight again with XP: test → reflect → retry, error rate decays each round

HALLUCINATED_TOOL.name: Hallucination Beast
HALLUCINATED_TOOL.trigger: Calls a non-existent tool when no sandbox/workspace is present
HALLUCINATED_TOOL.reality: Reality: tool calls need grounding — a real FS and executable environment.
HALLUCINATED_TOOL.mechanism: The agent cannot tell real APIs from invented ones without a sandbox or workspace to anchor reality.

FILE_CORROSION.name: Corrosion Worm
FILE_CORROSION.trigger: Multiple EDIT_FILE actions overwrite each other without Git
FILE_CORROSION.reality: Reality: in-place edits without version control cannot be rolled back.
FILE_CORROSION.mechanism: Without Git, each edit destroys the previous one until the file is corrupted.

MEMORY_STACK_OVERFLOW.name: Amnesia Demon
MEMORY_STACK_OVERFLOW.trigger: Too many steps with too little memory capacity
MEMORY_STACK_OVERFLOW.reality: Reality: the context window is a finite resource.
MEMORY_STACK_OVERFLOW.mechanism: Too many steps, too small a buffer — the agent forgets what it was doing.

CONTEXT_FULL.name: The Suffocator
CONTEXT_FULL.trigger: Memory usage hits capacity during retries
CONTEXT_FULL.counter: Add memory, or isolate context per agent with a graph
CONTEXT_FULL.reality: Reality: long chats and retry logs fill the context window.
CONTEXT_FULL.mechanism: Retry history fills the context; the agent can no longer process new information.

INFINITE_LOOP_TRAP.name: Infinite Loop Beast
INFINITE_LOOP_TRAP.trigger: No stop condition; retries exhausted with no progress
INFINITE_LOOP_TRAP.counter: Enable 'Stop on test pass' or raise max_retries
INFINITE_LOOP_TRAP.mechanism: Test fails → same fix → fails again. Without a stop condition, retries burn out.

TASK_ABANDONED.name: Quitter
TASK_ABANDONED.trigger: No loop strategy; one test failure abandons the task
TASK_ABANDONED.counter: Switch to Blind Retry or ReAct+Reflexion
TASK_ABANDONED.reality: Reality: a single-pass agent cannot recover from errors.
TASK_ABANDONED.mechanism: Without a loop strategy, the first failure ends the entire task.

reflections.reflect_test_fail: Last run failed an assertion. This time, read the full error before editing.
reflections.reflect_wrong_file: Last run edited the wrong file. This time, follow the stack trace to the real path.
reflections.reflect_off_by_one: Last run had an off-by-one boundary bug. This time, check loop and index bounds.
reflections.reflect_dependency: Last run missed a dependency import. This time, confirm the module is in scope.

failureHints.HALLUCINATED_TOOL: The agent tried to use a tool that doesn't exist — it hallucinated an API or package. This happens when there's no sandbox or workspace to ground the agent in reality.
failureHints.FILE_CORROSION: The agent overwrote its own work. Without Git to track changes, each edit destroyed the previous one, corrupting the final output.
failureHints.MEMORY_STACK_OVERFLOW: The agent ran out of memory. After too many steps without enough buffer space, it forgot what it was doing and reset.
failureHints.CONTEXT_FULL: The context window is completely full. During retries, the agent accumulated too much history and can no longer process new information.
failureHints.INFINITE_LOOP_TRAP: The agent is stuck in a loop: test fails → same fix → test fails again. Without a proper stop condition, it burned through all retries making no progress.
failureHints.TASK_ABANDONED: The agent gave up after the first failure. Without a loop strategy to retry, a single test failure ended the entire task.

failureFixes.HALLUCINATED_TOOL: Enable Sandbox and Workspace in the Harness config.
failureFixes.FILE_CORROSION: Enable Git in the Harness config to track file changes.
failureFixes.MEMORY_STACK_OVERFLOW: Increase Memory Capacity to at least 5.
failureFixes.CONTEXT_FULL: Increase Memory Capacity or use a multi-agent Graph to isolate context per agent.
failureFixes.INFINITE_LOOP_TRAP: Enable 'Stop on test pass' in Loop Strategy, or increase Max Retries.
failureFixes.TASK_ABANDONED: Switch Loop Strategy from 'None' to 'Blind Retry' or 'ReAct + Reflexion'.
